metadata.source: Survey of India (per src_agency attribute in the source data)
metadata.hosted_via: National Water Data Portal (NWDP), NWIC, Ministry of Jal Shakti -- https://nwdp.nwic.gov.in/
metadata.processing: reprojected to EPSG:4326, topology-preserving simplify (shared-arc, tolerance 0.0005 deg) so adjacent polygons never overlap/gap at shared borders, coords rounded 5dp, 0 feature(s) needed the per-feature fallback
metadata.level_note: SoI sub-district (sdcode) -- the closest available Survey of India product to Block/Tehsil; SoI's own block/bkcode grouping has no separate boundary product.
